productionMl.name: Active-Learning Labeling Pipeline
productionMl.summary: Labeling large volumes of sensor data is the bottleneck in every production ML cycle — and the labels that already exist are not necessarily right.
productionMl.approach: Built labeling workflows around Active Learning, so the pipeline ranks which samples are worth a human's attention instead of working through the queue in order. The same scoring pass is run over previously annotated data, where disagreement between model and label surfaces likely mislabels.
productionMl.outcome: Cut analysis time and manual labeling workload by ~50%, and surfaced mislabeled samples in data that had already been through annotation.

productionMl.name: Performance Analysis & Overfit Mapping
productionMl.summary: Models that look strong in the lab do not always hold up at inference time, and an aggregate accuracy number hides where they fail.
productionMl.approach: Built analytical tooling that compares lab and production behaviour and maps where a model overfits and underfits across its input space, turning a single metric into a picture of which regions are actually trustworthy. Wired into the release path so the check runs before deployment, not after.
productionMl.outcome: Exposed lab-to-production inference gaps, drove accuracy improvements across algorithm pipelines, and caught ~3 algorithmic bugs per model release before deployment.

productionMl.name: Time-Series Anomaly Detection & Enrichment
productionMl.summary: Sensor time-series arrives noisy, and the noise costs twice — once in training time, once in detection accuracy.
productionMl.approach: Developed time-series analysis, forecasting and anomaly-detection algorithms, with signal-noise and outlier reduction ahead of training. Separately automated data enrichment and labeling by integrating external APIs with tracking systems, recovering signal that the pipeline had been dropping.
productionMl.outcome: Cut both training and inference time while raising detection accuracy, and recovered thousands of previously missed tracks.
